svg.title: Agentopia agent concepts version one
svg.desc: Mochi, the personal agent, followed by seven colorful service-agent silhouettes and a shared state language strip.

g.text: One personal agent · seven service-agent identities
Mochi alone uses bright white linework · service agents vary through colorful arch-and-line squid silhouettes
Bright white linework is reserved for the
user's agent; a soft blush adds warmth.
A broad orange canopy and task badge
A tall violet dome and crown distinguish
this agent without defining its role.
A compact lime body and side fins make
this service identity easy to recognize.
A low cyan arch, four soft feet, and two
signal arcs keep the squid family playful.
A pink arch, curled feelers, and smiling
eyes create an expressive squid variant.
A narrow blue arch and tiny center feet
make a shy, vertically stretched squid.
A wide gold arch, layered crown lines,
and tiny arms make a cheerful squid.
Agent identity stays fixed; surrounding rings, paths, icons, and motion carry state.
A separate node keeps work visible.
Silhouette and identity must survive before facial detail does.
Confirm the shared squid silhouette family
wide, tall, compact, round, curled, layered, crowned
friendly faces, neutral visors, or role-specific mix
white linework only for Mochi; color for every other agent
